City of Chicago
                                                                    O2021-4805
                            Office ofthe City Clerk
                           Document Tracking Sheet



Meeting Date:                  10/25/2021
Sponsor(s):                    Hopkins (2)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No.3-G at 1535 N Dayton
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:



SECTION 1: That Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance, be amended by changing all the Residential Planned Development

No. 1427 symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 3-G in the area

bounded by:

      North Dayton Street; a line 33.66 feet south of and parallel to West Weed
      Street; the 16 foot public alley next east of and parallel to North Dayton
      Street; and a line 25 feet north of and parallel to West Biackhawk Street.


to the designation of C3-5.



SECTION 2: This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its

passage and due publication.




                                                             BRIAN HOPKINS,

                                                            Aldennan, 2"^ Ward
